newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 11.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Tuesday.
WASHINGTON - American Airlines, the country's second-largest air carrier, and its pilot union began talks aimed at heading off a strike that could begin at 12:01 a.m. EST on Saturday.
WASHINGTON - Sales of gourmet chocolate are booming, the latest example of Americans' love affair with pricey gourmet items such as coffee, ice cream, water and bread.

WASHINGTON - Finance ministers from the world's seven major industrial countries have acted to help stem the dollar's surge, but traders suggested that the dollar may start climbing again whether the ministers like it or not.
WASHINGTON - The president's Council of Economic Advisers lauded the nation's current combination of low unemployment and low inflation and said that it could continue more or less indefinitely.
